changelog:
auto-test-assistant 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Provides support for writing, debugging, and optimizing automated test scripts for major testing frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Pytest, Cypress, unittest, Jest, Appium, and Locust.
- Assists with tasks including creating test scripts, debugging failures, generating test reports, optimizing test code, and offering best practices.
- Generates Page Object model code, CI/CD configuration files, and Allure test reports.
- Offers guidance on test strategy, framework selection, test data management, and project structure organization.
- Includes detailed workflow and templates for common testing scenarios (E2E, API, performance, and more).
summary: 帮助编写、调试和优化自动化测试脚本，支持 Selenium、Playwright、Pytest、Cypress、unittest、Jest、Appium、Locust 等主流测试框架。当用户需要编写自动化测试、调试测试脚本、分析测试失败原因、生成测试报告、优化测试代码、或询问测试最佳实践时使用此技能。也适用于用户提到"写测试"、"测试脚本"、"自动化测试"、"test case"、"unit test"、"e2e test"、"API测试"、"性能测试"、"Page Object"等场景。支持生成 Page Object 模式代码、CI/CD 配置、Allure 测试报告。
